text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Kyaa~~!

"That day, shrill squeals of excitement 
echoed throughout Tracen Academy. The 
reason was—"

It was Fuji Kiseki. A very long line had 
formed in the courtyard.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I'll make sure to savor every 
bite of this chocolate you made with all 
your heart.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan A
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeees...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fan Club Member
text_block_list.text: Yes! Next in line, please!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I-I always watch your races...! I-I'm 
cheering for you, with all my heart!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I'll keep working hard to live 
up to your expectations.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan B
text_block_list.text: H-Hyeeek!

Fuji Kiseki greeted each person with a 
smile, carefully accepting every gift. The 
line showed no signs of ending anytime 
soon.
That night.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Good evening, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I'm so glad you're still working! I just 
couldn't make time during the day."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. And here I was hoping you might be 
looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Keep this a secret from everyone, okay? 
Happy Valentine's Day."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ………… Hm? Huh?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I made sure to prepare the chocolate, but 
I wonder where it went!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Things were a bit hectic earlier today, so 
maybe that was when... But I had it just a 
moment ago—

Fuji Kiseki frantically turned her pockets 
inside out one after another. However, the 
chocolate was nowhere to be found—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It looks like I lost it...! I'm so sorry, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
But... oh, right! How about your pockets, 
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Could you try checking Trainer's right 
pocket for me?

Thinking "It couldn't be," I reached into 
my pocket— and pulled out a piece of 
beautifully wrapped chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Was that a bit too clichÃ©? Since we 
had the chance, I really wanted to 
surprise you!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Likewise. I look forward to continuing to 
work with you, Trainer.

I spent a memorable Valentine's Day 
together with Fuji Kiseki.

Fuji Kiseki produced a gorgeous bouquet of 
flowers.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No, thank you for always being there! 
So... I actually have a favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
This might sound a bit strange, but... 
would it be alright if I had one of these 
flowers?

I wasn't entirely sure what was happening, 
but I had no reason to refuse. I nodded 
and said, "Of course."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! I was so hungry, I couldn't help 
it.

With those words, Fuji Kiseki brought the 
bouquet to her lips—
She ate the small rose whole, head first.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Mmm, delicious.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I love roses. Their thorns sting 
sometimes, but even that adds a nice 
little spice, you know?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
My top recommendation would have to be the 
red rose. It has a delightfully fruity 
sweetness.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Would you like a bite too, Trainer?

With those words, she gently handed me a 
bouquet. As I stood there bewildered, 
wondering what this was all about—

The sweet scent of caramel wafted through 
the air.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, did you notice? Sorry, it's actually 
candy craft!

Both the color and shape looked just like 
the real thing. You wouldn't know unless 
you looked closely.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I made it well. To be honest, 
I practiced a bit just for today.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to give you a surprise you'd 
never forget, Trainer. How was it?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Then it's a huge success. Glad to 
hear it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Well then, once again—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Roses are red, violets are blue, sugar is 
sweet, and so are you."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm counting on you from now on too, my 
Trainer.

I spent a memorable Valentine's Day 
together with Fuji Kiseki.
